note: Tolerances measured against NJOY2016.79, not assumed. Node-level bounds absorb the documented deep-tail residual: ACTINV's extreme sigma_t bins run ~2x shallower than NJOY's at sigma0<=1, and NJOY's own nladr noise is +-3% with a 6% internal direct-vs-ptable spread at that corner (measured on W-186 at nladr 32/64/128). Group-level bounds are the rate-channel (capture, fission) full-coverage factor deviations measured in the six-material GROUPR campaign: Ag-107 2.3%, Nb-93 2.3%, Ta-181 3.4%, Fe-56 6.4%, W-186 8.4%, U-238 13.2%. Total and elastic are reported per-channel but not gated: GROUPR's (sigma_pot+sigma0)/(sigma_t+sigma0) weight amplifies pointwise dips where the artifact's binned convention does not, producing systematic mid-sigma0 excursions up to ~50% that are a documented method difference, not an implementation defect. The sigma0=inf absolute-xs column is reported separately as inf_xs_max because the artifact's unshielded collapse uses ladder-statistics averages while GROUPR collapses the pointwise file — a real convention difference visible on Fe-56, U-238 and Nb-93 that the runtime does not consume (runtime scales the library's own unshielded xs by the factor). Partially-covered groups whose uncovered sliver sits inside a resolved range carry the declared resolved-region non-claim and are reported, not gated.
